business.title: Proximater for Business
business.pitch: Remember when YouTube turned anyone with a camera into a content creator? We're doing that for location services. While Google Maps makes businesses jump through hoops to update their listings and Just Eat delivers your dinner, Proximater lets every business broadcast their presence in real-time.
business.idea: The idea is simple: broadcast the second you open your front door. Your customers are walking past right now - let them know you exist.
business.audience: Independent retailers, pop-up shops, market stalls, food trucks, mobile services - if you're open for business right now, you can be discovered instantly by people nearby.

social.title: A Social Solution
social.subtitle: Proximater will bring nearby people together.
social.text:
Have you ever thought that there must be someone to meet, or a person offering a service nearby that you won't find on your usual maps app because it would be more of a temporary endeavour? That is where Proximater comes in.

As a social user, or a business you can easily create a broadcast, or pick up Proximater to see what's around.

Proximater will be for anyone, here and now.

Protecting your privacy, only your approximate location is shared in search results for social broadcasts. You can share your accurate location on request.

broadcast.question: What is a broadcast?
broadcast.answer: A broadcast is essentially like a business (or social) listing with a single picture taken directly from your camera, up to 5 tags to describe it, along with your location. The broadcast can be a maximum length of 10 hours to keep information fresh. Your location is placed on a map, and a card-type view is used in a list for when users pick up the app to see what is nearby.

account.question: How do I create a user account
account.answer:
Proximater is free to play so you do not need a user account to see what is around you!

If you wish to create a broadcast or navigate then you will need to sign in using your Apple or Google account or create a user account with your email address.

dataSecurity.question: How are you protecting my sensitive data?
dataSecurity.answer:
Proximater has been built from the ground up around the best information security practices available for mobile apps. We were able to do this by tapping into the years of experience that our team has ascertained from delivering mobile apps for corporate and consumer household names.

By working towards ISO-27001 certification, we have an ongoing commitment to ensure that security is managed, and maintained.

download.question: How can I download Proximater?
download.answer: Proximater is available to download now from the Apple App Store, and Google Play Store, find download links at the bottom of the page.

privacy.question: How does Proximater protect my privacy?
privacy.answer: You can use Proximater to share your location. On top of the strictest operating-system level permissions, through clear messaging and embedded features you always know where you are with your privacy.

responsibility.question: How is Proximater being socially responsible?
responsibility.contentText:
We do not wish for content to appear on Proximater that may be deemed offensive or inappropriate for minors.

To tackle this from launch we have almighty OpenAI, and AWS AI integrations, which are doing a great job at blocking inappropriate content.
responsibility.environmentText: We are determined to find concrete solutions using the latest technology to support biodiversity and the environment. Proximater will hopefully help with that.
